verdict: Keep 300 DPI unless tokens matter more than a small accuracy risk. On RealKIE invoices 200 DPI scored the same as 300 (0.82 against 0.81) with 7% fewer tokens per page; 150 DPI scored 0.79, a drop within the noise, with 12% fewer. Below about 200 DPI Textract starts to drop small and faint characters, so test a lower resolution on your own scans first.
